answer: Proof of Personhood serves as a trellis for sybil resistance, ensuring that an opal of digital uniqueness validates each node. By anchoring agent identity to authenticated biometric hashes, the system prevents automated identity replication. An attacker attempting to scale fake accounts must procure human labor, a cost akin to harvesting rare timber. This requirement forces the expenditure of real-world resources, effectively rendering sybil-driven network monopolization economically irrational.
